description: Students examine the artistic heritage of the German-speaking countries and develop the skill of
interpreting and analyzing art works in their cultural context. The specific topic may vary and may
be broadly or narrowly defined to include a specific art form, theme, period, artist, or the art of
the German-speaking countries. Topics include: the arts in turn-of-the-century Vienna, the
Bauhaus, Weimar cinema, and German Expressionism. Taught in English. Counts toward the
German major or German studies concentration. May be repeated if topics differ. Offered
